findings: On 126c7659 a conflicted identity stays excluded for the whole pass. A later same-signature copy cannot restore pooled or cohort membership. Non-conflicting ineligible seats can still be replaced. Pooled exclusion_reasons records INTEGRITY_CONFLICT.

Permutations of [A,A,B] and of three cohorts where two signatures match keep observed_target_n at 0 and mean null. The owner readout shows INTEGRITY_CONFLICT, distinct from an empty cohort. DocumentRunner still carries by_cohort. V1 remains readable.
INTEGRITY_CONFLICT persists through later copies, including a new cohort. Exclusion stays visible on the result and on by_cohort. V1 without by_cohort stays readable and is not rewritten.

Section 5.1 names INTEGRITY_CONFLICT as N=0 and mean null on pooled and every touched cohort, distinct from an empty cohort and from a missing target. format_discovery_readout copies exclusion_reasons and by_cohort.
